title: T2T-VICL: Cross-Task Visual In-Context Learning via Implicit Text-Driven VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2511.16107v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual in-context learning (VICL) solves visual tasks by conditioning on a few input-output demonstrations without any model training. Recent advances in large vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising VICL capability when the demonstration pair and the query belong to the same vision task, but real use cases often provide mismatched examples, making it unclear whether a VLM should imitate the demonstrated transformation or infer a new one from the query. This raises a fundamental question: Can VLMs perform cross-task VICL where demonstration and query differ? In the paper, we study this cross-task VICL setting and propose T2T-VICL, a collaborative prompt-transfer framework, which converts mismatched visual demonstrations into implicit textual guidance without explicitly naming the tasks. translated_title: T2T-VICL：基于隐式文本驱动视觉语言模型的跨任务视觉上下文学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.16107v5 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：视觉上下文学习（VICL）通过以少量输入-输出示例为条件来解决视觉任务，而无需任何模型训练。大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展已经展现出良好的VICL能力，即当示例对与查询属于同一视觉任务时；但在实际应用场景中，往往会提供不匹配的示例，这使得VLM应该模仿示例中所演示的变换，还是从查询中推断出新的变换变得不明确。这引出了一个基本问题：VLM能否执行示例与查询不一致的跨任务VICL？在本文中，我们研究了这种跨任务VICL设置，并提出了T2T-VICL，一个协作式的提示迁移框架，它将不匹配的视觉示例转换为隐式的文本指导，而无需显式地命名任务。为此，一个大型教师VLM首先生成关于视觉变化以及任务对之间任务差异的结构化描述……
tldr: 提出T2T-VICL协作式提示迁移框架，通过将不匹配的视觉示例转化为隐式文本指导，使视觉语言模型能够在示例与查询分属不同任务时完成跨任务视觉上下文学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes T2T-VICL, a collaborative prompt-transfer framework that converts mismatched visual demonstrations into implicit textual guidance, enabling VLMs to perform cross-task visual in-context learning where demonstrations and queries belong to different tasks.
